long_biography.plain_text:
Auckland charter entrepreneur Craig Armstrong has a family link to boatbuilding: his grandfather built boats. He developed private excursions that could be short celebrations or extended journeys. Cruise New Zealand pairs professional crews with dining and water-based activities, turning boat hire into a hosted visitor experience.

Armstrong has used relationships with local helicopter and lodge operators to broaden guests' itineraries beyond the water. He has also made marine ecology and conservation part of the charter experience. Returning guests can book trips with crews familiar with the region, a feature Armstrong has singled out as important to the business.
